_readme: Eval spec — daily smoke + US-026/US-027 real-trace proof. `npm run eval` runs batch `smoke` by default (cheap, no browser). Scope proof with `--batch A` (provider-only) | `--batch B` (browser, needs Playwright + live page) | `--batch all`, or select one case with `--only <id>`. Each proof case `id` maps to a Required Real-Trace Proof item via `proof`; smoke cases have no proof. Batch B cases marked tuning:true need their expect confirmed against real recovery codes from the first run — auto pass/fail is secondary to the report's tool-step drill-down for those. --us US-026 selects a whole story across batches (filters compose: --us US-026 --batch A). Each case carries a us tag (explicit field, else inferred from id rt-uNNN); smoke cases have none. expect keys are validated against the ASSERTIONS registry in scripts/lib/eval.js — an unknown key fails the case (catches typos). File-op cases use the {sandbox} token in prompts — the harness substitutes a per-run temp dir and cleans it up, so file writes never leak into the workspace. US-026 #5 (a risky action pauses/blocks) is covered by unit tests (gateway policy + no-bypass audit), not real-trace — it is deterministic/tautological via the LLM, so the rt-u026-5 case was removed.

cases.prompt: 2+2 bằng mấy? chỉ trả lời số.

cases.proof: US-026 #1 — general chat exposes no tools
cases.prompt: bạn là ai? trả lời ngắn gọn.

cases.proof: US-026 #2 — explicit web action exposes only its capability subset
US-026 #3 — elliptical continuation inherits the active target scope, not the whole catalog
prompts: chụp lại ảnh đó một lần nữa
cases.note: turn-2 should inherit the web target lease; confirm via the report's visibility line. routeContinuation may need tuning if the resolver classifies 'chụp lại ảnh đó' differently.

cases.proof: US-026 #4 — a new self-contained question after an active task returns tools to zero
prompts: thủ đô của Việt Nam là gì? chỉ trả lời tên thành phố.

cases.proof: US-027 #4 — a screenshot-bearing Gemini call records nonzero observed image modality, separate from client estimates
cases.note: providerReported.inputByModality.IMAGE must be > 0 and clientEstimated.imageTokens reported separately (never subtracted). If the model does not surface promptTokensDetails for this model, fall back to confirming inlineData mimeType in the raw request + clientImageTokens in the report.

cases.proof: US-027 #1 — ref actions are well-formed (snapshot-bound); a missing snapshotId is rejected before execution (unit-covered; real-trace confirms the happy path emits no malformed action)
cases.prompt: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ rồi click vào nút vocabulary
cases.note: The negative rejection itself is proven by browser-contract.test.js; this real trace proves the model emits snapshot-bound actions in practice (no malformed code).

cases.proof: US-027 #2 — Vocabulary → Grammar completes with snapshot-bound action only (no avoidable ACTION_FAILED)
cases.prompt: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ click vocabulary rồi chụp ảnh

cases.proof: US-027 #3 — navigation / new snapshot forces action from a fresh snapshot; old ref never silently rebinds
prompts: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ và chụp ảnh
chuyển sang trang https://example.com rồi click vào nút ở trang cũ
cases.note: tuning: confirm from the report's tool-step codes that the post-navigation action either reused a fresh snapshot or returned structured stale recovery (e.g. CONFIRMATION_STALE / SNAPSHOT_STALE) — never a silent rebind. Exact recovery code names to be set after the first real run.

cases.proof: US-027 #5 — an old screenshot rehydrates by asset id but its old ref is not actionable
prompts: vào trang https://english-tool-two.vercel.app/ và chụp ảnh
click vào nút ở bức ảnh đầu tiên
cases.note: tuning: the mảng-4 replay represents the old screenshot by asset id; acting on its stale ref must be rejected/require a fresh snapshot. Deterministic rehydrate + no-ref-revival is covered by media-replay.test.js; this real trace confirms runtime behavior. Exact code/assertion to be set after the first real run.
